articles.title: Our users experience with the Nebula app
articles.body:
When it comes to navigating relationships and seeking spiritual guidance, we understand that the journey can require time, dedication, and introspection. It’s essential to stay motivated and open-minded as you seek clarity and connection.
The Nebula app offers a notification system to keep you engaged, reminding you of key insights and spiritual practices. Our team is here to support you every step of the way, providing personalized recommendations, insightful readings, and a listening ear when you need it most.
We are honored to be part of so many personal transformation stories. We understand that improving relationships and finding happiness can take time, and it can be challenging to maintain that momentum. But you’re not alone — our community and resources are here to guide and uplift you.
 
We are pleased to share some of the feedback from our users who have embarked on their relationship journeys with Nebula. Their stories highlight the growth, understanding, and happiness they’ve gained along the way:

articles.title: What’s Nebula?
articles.body:
Nebula is a leading spiritual guidance platform, offering personalized insights to help users gain clarity in their lives and relationships. Launched by OBRIO in April 2019, Nebula quickly gained prominence, becoming the top astrology app in the USA by the summer of 2020 and achieving global leadership by the summer of 2021.
Over the past 5 years, Nebula has recognized that the key to personal well-being often lies in the quality of one’s relationships and understanding of oneself. By focusing on spiritual guidance, Nebula helps users navigate life decisions through personalized insights tailored to their unique needs.
Nebula stands out as a guide to clarity in life and relationships, providing users with the tools to improve self-awareness, understand their values, potential, and purpose, and strengthen their relationships by offering deeper insights into themselves and others.
Today, Nebula is one of the most popular spiritual guidance platforms globally. According to Sensor Tower, Nebula became the most downloaded astrology app in the USA during the summer of 2020 and reached worldwide leadership by 2021. Available for free on iOS and Android, Nebula has been downloaded more than 60 million times, with over 1 million daily users.
Many times, Nebula became №1 lifestyle app by the number of daily downloads in the USA, UK, Canada, and France. We were ahead of even such a giant as Tinder. 
Nebula is about:

• Personalization — every reading, report, and piece of advice is tailored to the individual, ensuring that users receive insights that are relevant and specific to their circumstances.

• Clarity — users come to Nebula seeking clarity, and that’s what we provide. We help our users gain a clearer understanding of themselves, their relationships, and their life decisions.

• Spiritual Insights — our platform brings together a wide array of spiritual practices — astrology, psychic readings, tarot, numerology, and more — so that users can explore their inner world and receive meaningful guidance.

Ask Nebula. Get Clarity.
 
Have any questions? 
Please feel free to contact our support team, and we will be happy to assist you!

articles.title: Which features are included?
articles.body:
1. Nebula App
2. AskNebula Website
3. Need more help?
 
1. Nebula App
With Nebula app premium subscription, you can:

• Enjoy the app without any Ads.

• Receive exclusive horoscopes, astrology readings, and advanced forecasts for days, weeks, and months ahead, offering you deep and personalized guidance to help you make informed decisions that can positively impact your life.

• Enhance your romantic and social connections.

• Find the answers about relationships using our "Compatibility" premium feature.

• Receive the answers from our psychics that are always ready to provide the support and guidance you seek, when you need, as well as our professional Customer Support team.

Nebula premium subscription can be ordered right away from inside the application.
After downloading the app and after accessing the personal account on the main page in the Nebula application, you will receive the pop-up menu about premium access.
Also, you can open this popup from inside "Horoscope" tab tapping on "Unlock forever" button and from the "Settings" menu at "Unlock All Features" section.
Please note that the "Yearly" subscription is preselected, so to order a 3-day trial user should select it.
After tapping on the "Continue" button, the user will be redirected to AppStore or PlayMarket check out where the user can see all information about selected subscription, and its price.

2. AskNebula Website

Our website premium subscription provides:

• Chats with professional psychics: the primary feature is access to one-on-one chats with our skilled and certified psychics. After subscribing or accepting the trial plan, chat credits will be added to your account for use.

• Personalized readings: users can receive in-depth readings tailored to their astrological data, offering insights into their personality, future, and more.

• Personal horoscopes: access to daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly horoscopes customized to your zodiac sign and other astrological factors.

• Astrological articles: enjoy a library of interesting and educational articles written by our expert advisors, covering a wide range of astrology-related topics.

Additionally, we are constantly improving and adding new features, so stay tuned for updates — there are many exciting additions coming soon!
 
3. Need more help?
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact our support team, and we will be happy to assist you!

articles.title: How can I restore my account?
articles.body:
If your Nebula account has been deleted and you’d like to restore it, this article will explain what recovery options may be available depending on how you used Nebula.
Please choose the option that matches your case below.

• If you used the Nebula app on iOS or Android

• If you used AskNebula Web

• If you still can’t restore your account

 
If you used the Nebula app on iOS or Android
If you used Nebula through the mobile app, you can restore your previous account directly in the app within 28 days after deleting it.
To restore your account:

• Open the Nebula app.

•
Tap Log in.

👇 If you see the Create an account screen first, tap Log in under Already a member.

         3. Choose the same sign-in method you used for your previous account:

• Continue with Apple

• Continue with Facebook

• Continue with Google

• Continue with Email

         4. If you used email and password, enter the email address and password connected to your deleted account.
         After that, you should see a confirmation window asking if you want to restore your account. Tap Restore previous account to confirm.
       5. If you previously used Google, Facebook, or Apple, choose the same login method.
In this case, your account should be restored automatically, and you may not see an additional confirmation window. 
Once your account is restored, you’ll be able to continue using Nebula.
Please make sure you use the same sign-in method or email address that was connected to your deleted account.
 
If you used AskNebula Web
If your deleted account was connected to AskNebula Web, unfortunately, it cannot be restored after deletion.
We understand this may be disappointing, especially if you were hoping to get access back. However, once this type of account has been deleted, it is no longer available for recovery.
If you’d like to continue using Nebula, please create a new account. You’ll be able to start fresh and use the service again!
 
If you still can’t restore your account
If you followed the steps above but still can’t access your account, please contact our Support Team.
When contacting us, please include:

• the email address linked to your Nebula account;

• the sign-in method you used, if you remember it;

• a short description of what happens when you try to log in, with screenshots or a screen recording if possible.

Our Support Team will check your case and let you know what options are available.

For the best experience, please open the email on your mobile phone and click the button directly — this ensures a smooth transition into the app.

articles.title: How to remove personal data or delete the account?
articles.body:
1. AskNebula Website Account Deletion
2. Nebula App Account Deletion
3. Need more help?
 
1. AskNebula Website Account Deletion
In order to remove your personal data on AskNebula website, please follow these steps:
1.  Log in to your account.

2.  Tap the "Settings" gear icon at the top.
4.  In the "Manage personal data" tab, located in the "Legal & Privacy" section, you can delete all personal information and your account.
       
5.  Once you've completed these steps, you'll receive an email confirming the account deletion process. Click the "Confirm deactivation" button in this email to finalize the deletion.
 
If you're accessing AskNebula via desktop, follow the same steps as above.
📸 Refer to the screenshots below for a step-by-step visual guide on how to complete the process.
Once you've completed these steps, you'll receive an email confirming the account deletion process. Click the "Confirm deactivation" button in this email to finalize the deletion.
⚠️ Please note:
Once your AskNebula Website account deletion is confirmed, this process cannot be reversed, and the deleted account cannot be restored.
 
2. Nebula App Account Deletion
In order to remove your personal data on Nebula app, please follow these steps:
1.  Open the Nebula app.
2.  Tap the Settings icon in the top right corner.

3.  Under the General tab, tap Account details.
4.  Select Delete account.
5. Confirm your choice by tapping Delete again.
⚠️ Please note:
Your profile and chat data may be retained for up to 28 days before being permanently deleted.
If you change your mind during this time, you may be able to restore your account. Please follow the steps in this article: How can I restore my account?
 
3. Need more help?

articles.body:

If you haven’t received a response from your advisor or are unhappy with the quality of the reading, we’re here to help. Please follow the steps below depending on the type of chat you had:
 
1. Check the Chat Type
Messenger (Offline Text Message)
If you sent a message while the psychic was busy or offline, they may take up to 48 hours to respond — although most replies come sooner.
🕒 Please be patient — our psychics prioritize live sessions, but will respond to offline messages as soon as they’re available.
 
Live Chat
If you’re in a live chat and experience issues such as:

• Psychic is not answering

• Poor or unclear quality of the reading

Please report the issue using the “Contact Us” option on our app or by submitting a request directly from the Help Center.
 
2. Contact our support team through the Nebula app
1. Go to the "Settings" menu on the "Horoscope" tab.
2. Click on the "Help and Support" button and submit a request with your issue. (Using the app to contact us provides info about your device, helping us investigate.)
 
3. Contact our support team directly from Help Center
You can also contact us directly from the Help Center by clicking the button below — we’ll be happy to assist you!

Submit a request
 

4. Provide the following details to expedite the process:

When submitting your request, please include the following details:

• A brief description of the issue (and a screenshot, if possible)

• Your name (check in your profile under Personal Information)

• Your date of birth (format: YYYY-MM-DD)

articles.title: Why is the message blurred? Why should I pay to see the answer in a chat?
articles.body:
1. Will I Be Charged?
2. Why Do I Need Credits Then?
3. How Can I Add Credits?
4. Need more help?
 
Sometimes when you open a chat with one of our psychics, you might notice that their response appears blurred. In some cases, a blurred preview may also appear in your chat list.
This can happen when your balance does not meet the minimum requirement needed to view the response or continue the chat.
Don’t worry - you are not charged just to unlock or view a blurred message! 
1. Will I Be Charged?
No. You won’t be charged just to view a blurred psychic response.
Unlocking the message is free, and no credits are deducted from your account simply for removing the blur.
However, your balance still needs to meet a minimum requirement before the message can become visible.

2. Why Do I Need Credits Then?

Credits are needed as a balance eligibility check. This confirms that your balance is enough to continue or restart the chat if you choose to do so.
The exact minimum balance requirement may vary depending on the platform you use and the specific chat. If your balance does not meet the requirement, you’ll be prompted to top up before the message can become visible.
This is only a viewing requirement:

• No credits are used just for unlocking the message.

• You are charged only if you continue the conversation, send a new chat message, or send an offline message to the psychic.

3. How Can I Add Credits?

You have two easy options:
1. Click the "SEE THE MESSAGE" button. You’ll be directed to top up your balance. Once completed, the blur will disappear and you can read the message - no charge applied.
2. Or simply buy a credit package directly through the app or website. As long as your balance meets the minimum requirement, the blurred message will become instantly visible - again, with no deduction unless you take action.
 
4. Need more help?
If you topped up your balance and the message is still blurred, please contact our support team. We’re here to help and will resolve it as quickly as possible!

articles.body:
How to Access Your Reading
Need more help?
 
If you’re having trouble opening your reading purchased through social media (such as Instagram, Facebook, or TikTok), don’t worry — here’s how to fix it:
 
How to Access Your Reading
After purchasing your report or reading, you should receive an email with access details within 30 minutes. The email will be sent to the email address you used during checkout. Look for a message with the subject line: "Get your readings ✨" — or a similar subject that may include the name of your specific reading, such as Palmistry, Starseed, or Compatibility Reading etc.
💡 Don’t forget to check your Spam, Promotions, or Junk folders just in case.
To view your reading, make sure you have the AskNebula mobile app installed. Your reading is only available inside the Readings tab in the app.
Click the “Get my reading” button (or similar) in the email. This will redirect you to the Readings tab in the Nebula app, where you can access your purchased reading.
🔹 If you haven’t downloaded the Nebula app yet:
Clicking the “Get my reading” button will take you to the App Store or Google Play to install the app.
Once the installation is complete, return to the email and tap the button again — you’ll be logged in automatically and redirected to the Readings tab, where your purchased content will be available.
🔹If you already have the Nebula app installed:
Сlicking the “Get my reading” button will log you into your account and redirect you to the Readings tab, where all your purchased readings will appear.

For the best experience, please open the email on your mobile phone and click the button directly — this ensures a smooth transition into the app.

If you haven’t received the email after 30 minutes, be sure to check your spam or junk folder, and confirm that you entered the correct email address during purchase.

 
Need more help?
If you're having trouble opening your reading, please reach out to us for help, and we will be happy to assist you!

articles.title: I encountered an error while trying to purchase credits
articles.body:
1. What to Do First
2. How to Contact Support
3. Common Reasons for Payment Errors
4. Need more help?
 
If you're seeing an error while trying to purchase credits on the Nebula app, don’t worry — it’s usually easy to resolve.
Use the steps below to troubleshoot and get back on track.
 
1. What to Do First

•
Take a Screenshot of the Error

If you receive an error like "An error processing your order", take a screenshot or write down the exact message. This helps our support team quickly identify the cause.
 

•
Double-Check Your Payment Info

Make sure your card number, CVV, and expiry date are correct. Also, confirm that your card is valid and has sufficient funds.

 
2. How to Contact Support
To report the issue:
1. Open the Nebula app
2. Tap the gear icon in the top-right corner to access Settings
3. Select "Help and Support".
Please include the following information:

• A description of the issue

• A screenshot of the error message

• (If applicable) The cardholder name, last 4 digits of the card, or PayPal email used for the transaction

 
3. Common Reasons for Payment Errors
Here are the most frequent reasons why a credit purchase may fail in the Nebula app:

•
Your debit card doesn’t support online payments
Some debit cards are restricted from making online purchases. Please contact your bank to confirm, or try using a different payment method (such as a credit card or PayPal).

•
Insufficient funds
Make sure your card or PayPal account has enough funds to cover the transaction.

•
Incorrect card details
Double-check that you’ve entered the correct card number, expiration date, and CVV code.

•
Expired card
If your card has expired, use a valid card with an active expiration date.

•
Card limit exceeded
Your card may have a daily or transaction limit. Contact your bank to check and, if needed, increase the limit.

•
Bank communication or security issues
Some banks apply additional fraud protection or require extra verification. If a transaction is declined without a clear reason, contact your bank to ensure there are no restrictions or blocks in place for online payments.

⚠️ Please note: After multiple failed attempts, our system may temporarily block further purchases for security reasons. If this happens, don’t hesitate to contact our Support Team — we’re here to help you resolve the issue quickly.
 
4. Need more help?
If these instructions don’t work for you or you encounter any issues, please feel free to contact our support team, and we will be happy to assist you!

articles.body:
1. Contact our support team directly from the Help Center
2. Contact our support team through the Nebula app
3. Contact our support team through the AskNebula Website
4. Provide details to expedite the process

 

This issue is very rare and usually related to a specific account or technical error. If it happens to you, don’t worry — our Support Team will handle it promptly.

 

1. Contact our support team directly from Help Center

You can also contact us directly from the Help Center by clicking the button below — we’ll be happy to assist you!

Submit a request

 

2. Contact our support team through the Nebula app

Please reach out to us via the “Contact us” option in the Nebula app:

1. Tap the gear icon in the top right corner to open Settings.

2. Select “Help and Support” and submit your request.

Using this method helps us automatically receive technical information about your device and account, which speeds up the resolution process.

 

3. Contact our support team through the AskNebula Website

• Click on the icon with your name in the top right corner of the screen.

• From the drop-down menu, select "Contact us".

• You’ll be connected to our Virtual Assistant, Celeste, who will guide you through your request.

• If Celeste isn’t able to resolve your issue, she’ll connect you to a Support Agent for further assistance.

 

4. Provide the following details to expedite the process:

• A brief description of the issue

• Screenshots of any transactions or changes in your credits balance

• A note on what actions you performed just before the issue occurred (especially if something seemed unusual)

Once we receive your message, we’ll investigate thoroughly. If there was an issue on our end, we’ll:

• Credit any missing amounts

• Possibly offer a bonus as an apology for the inconvenience

We’re committed to helping you get back to enjoying Nebula without disruption. 💫

articles.body:

    1.2 AskNebula Website

Accurate astrological insights depend on the correct representation of your zodiac and ascendant signs. If you find them incorrect, follow this guide to address the issue:
 
1. Verify your profile information:

     1.1 Nebula App

• Tap the settings gear icon
• Select "My Profile"
• Tap the arrow next to the incorrect detail and update it

     1.2 AskNebula Website

• Click the settings gear icon located on the main page
•
Go to "Personal Information" and update your details

  
 

2. Ensure accurate details:
Re-enter the following information:

• Date of Birth: (day, month, and year).

• Place of Birth: (specific city and country).

• Time of Birth: (exact time, down to the minute, if possible).

You can try refreshing your profile by temporarily changing some details, saving them, and then entering the correct information again. This can sometimes fix display issues.
 
3. Understand the sign transition:

• Zodiac transitions are not always at midnight. The time the Sun moves from one sign to another can vary based on your location. For instance, the Sun may transition into Virgo at 6:02 AM in New York but at 3:02 AM in Los Angeles.

• Leap years and location can also shift transition dates, making the exact time and place of your birth essential for accuracy.

By ensuring you provide the exact birth time and location, the app will calculate your signs and chart correctly.
 
4. Need more help?

articles.title: Where is my reading ordered on Social networks (Facebook, Instagram)?
articles.body:
After purchasing your report or reading, you should receive an email with access details within 30 minutes. The email will be sent to the email address you used during checkout. Look for a message with the subject line: "Get your readings ✨" — or a similar subject that may include the name of your specific reading, such as Palmistry, Starseed, or Compatibility Reading etc.
To view your reading, make sure you have the AskNebula mobile app installed. Your reading is only available inside the Readings tab in the app.
Click the “Get my reading” button (or similar) in the email. This will redirect you to the Readings tab in the Nebula app, where you can access your purchased reading.
🔹 If you haven’t downloaded the Nebula app yet:
Clicking the “Get my reading” button will take you to the App Store or Google Play to install the app.
Once the installation is complete, return to the email and tap the button again — you’ll be logged in automatically and redirected to the Readings tab, where your purchased content will be available.
🔹If you already have the Nebula app installed:
Сlicking the “Get my reading” button will log you into your account and redirect you to the Readings tab, where all your purchased readings will appear.

For the best experience, please open the email on your mobile phone and click the button directly — this ensures a smooth transition into the app.

If you haven’t received the email after 30 minutes, be sure to check your spam or junk folder, and confirm that you entered the correct email address during purchase.

articles.body:
If you're getting an error message when logging into your Nebula account, it could be due to one of the following common issues:
 
1. "Invalid email or password" error:

• Double-check your email and password. Ensure Caps Lock isn't on and you're using the correct keyboard language.

•
If you still can't log in, try resetting your password. Follow this guide: How to reset the password?
 

2. "Something went wrong" or "Unexpected error" messages:

• These errors may occur due to system issues or updates.

•
Please contact our support team through the "Submit Request" option in the app or by clicking the button below, and we will investigate and resolve the issue for you.
